review.notes: Structure audit: no code fences; all 51 headings checked against the PDF text layer; 22 headings whose text exists only inside the Figure 1 pipeline image (physical p.5) are demoted to plain text, each verified on the rendered p.5 and a 400 dpi crop of the "Stage 1" banner (the figure prints Arabic "1" and its own "PLANING" spelling, so only the heading marker is removed). Droppage: normalized 10-gram diff of all 38 PDF pages against the OCR found no missing prose; abstract, contents, all section bodies, all 15 figure captions, all 111 reference entries and the page-1 project-page link are present; the vertical arXiv sidebar stamp on p.1 is not transcribed, matching project convention. No tables exist in the PDF; no spaced digits or Markdown escapes altering visible text were found outside figure-internal transcription. Equations (1)-(4) and the inline math notation were compared against the PDF text as LaTeX-equivalent and left unchanged.
